data.y9c_1990s_source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, Holding Company Data page https://www.chicagofed.org/banking/financial-institution-reports/bhc-data (static links, 139 quarterly files BHCF86Q3..BHCF21Q1). File URL pattern https://www.chicagofed.org/~/media/others/banking/financial-institution-reports/bhc-data/bhcfYYMM.csv (plain comma-separated text, header = item codes, one row per reporting holding company; the same file carries FR Y-9C (BHCK/BHDM items), FR Y-9LP (BHCP) and FR Y-9SP (BHSP) data). Fetched 2026-11-21 with User-Agent 'research-reverify/1.0', >= 2 s between requests; all 42 requests HTTP 200, no 403/429.
data.y9c_1990s_files: bhcf9003, 9006, 9009, 9012, 9103 ... 9912 (all 40 quarters 1990Q1-1999Q4) + bhcf0003, bhcf0006 (overlap check only). 324 MB raw; sha256 per file in logs/p4b_02_raw_sha256.txt (and logs/p4b_02_download.log for the 41 files fetched by the script). Needed columns extracted to cache/bhcf_items.parquet (166,840 rows); raw files deleted after extraction if the environment permits (state recorded in the final report)
data.y9c_2000_plus: dump-based phase-4 panel phase4/cache/y9c_panel.parquet (read-only) - used only for the 2025 record and for the overlap check
data.overlap_check_result_recorded_before_fre: report dates 2000-03-31 and 2000-06-30: 1,729 / 1,744 filers common to the Chicago Fed files and the dump (the dump has 1 extra filer each date); CI, CRE, RRE, CC, OC, five-category total, bhck2170, bhck2122 and all shares identical (max |diff| 0) under the rules below (out/y9c_overlap_check_2000.csv)
data.sloos: phase4/out/s1_N_by_release.csv (read-only): N_CI, N_CRE, N_RRE, N_CC, N_OC by fred_date; release dates from it (= out/release_dates_US_SLOOS.csv columns release_date and approx_release_regular_practice)
data.crsp_daily_1990s: dump legacy crsp_a_stock.dsf (SIZ), phase-4 permno set (permnos of any linked permco U bank SIC 6020-6029 / 6710-6712), 1990-01-02..2000-12-29: cache/crsp_bank_dsf_1990s.parquet (2,594,764 rows, 1,818 permnos). Same file family as phase-4 S1 (phase 4 kept 1995+ only). dsf_v2 is not used for the 1990s (legacy dsf covers them and matches phase 4)
data.delisting_1990s: phase4/cache/delist.parquet (dump dsedelist + last exchcd), phase-4 rule
data.calendar: 1990s: dump crsp_a_stock.dsi dates with non-null vwretd (cache/dsi_1989_2025.parquet, ends 2024-12-31). 2025 record: dates with >= 100 records in the dsf_v2 extract (identical to dsi on all 147 days 2024-06-03..2024-12-31; 250 days in 2025)
data.crsp_daily_2025: dump crsp_a_stock.dsf_v2 (CIZ), same permno set, 2024-06-03..2025-12-31: cache/crsp_bank_dsfv2_2024_25.parquet (156,680 rows, 409 permnos)

sample_1990s.window: SLOOS releases with fred_date 1990-07-01 .. 2000-04-01 (40 releases, 1990-08 .. 2000-05-19; spec section 2). The release with fred_date 2000-07-01 (2000-08-25) is used only to date the exit of the last period
sample_1990s.release_date: exact release_date when present; else approx_release_regular_practice (27 releases of the window: fred_date 1990-07-01 .. 1996-10-01 and 1999-04-01). The approximate dates = fred_date + median 1997-2001 lag by quarter-of-year (38 / 50 / 54 / 47 days), rule reproduced exactly (logs/p4b_13)
sample_1990s.not_formable_by_data: the Y-9C real-estate breakdown (BHDM1415, BHDM1460, BHDM1480, BHDM1797) is first reported for 1990-09-30 (logs/p4b_10_bhcf_coverage.csv; MDRM start 1990-09-30). Under the 75-day rule the 1990-08 (approx 1990-08-24) and 1990-11 (approx 1990-11-17) releases map to reports dated 1990-03-31 and 1990-06-30, which have only total real estate (BHCK1410): no CRE share and no BT can be built, and the two-quarter fallback cannot reach a later report. These two releases are NOT formed (no portfolio, no H1 / H2 value); no proxy (e.g. total real estate) is substituted because it would change the signal. Expected formed periods: 38 (25 with approximate dates: 1991-02 .. 1996-11 and 1999-05; 13 exact: 1997-02 .. 2000-05 without 1999-05)
sample_1990s.categories: categories with a finite N at the release's fred_date: CI and CRE for fred_date 1990-07-01 .. 1995-10-01; CI, CRE, CC, OC from 1996-01-01; RRE none in the window (spec section 2; phase-4 category_N)

y9c_items_1990s.usable_report: a report row is usable iff bhck2170 > 0 (FR Y-9C filer), its report date is >= 1990-09-30, and the five-category loan total L > 0. 1990-03-31 and 1990-06-30 rows (3,149) are not usable (no breakdown). No duplicate (rssd9001, report date) in any file
y9c_items_1990s.CI: bhck1763 + bhck1764 (missing 1764 -> 0) when bhck1763 is present, else bhck1766 (phase-4 rule; 1763 + 1764 = 1766 in 100% of rows in every quarter)
y9c_items_1990s.CRE: construction BHDM1415 + multifamily BHDM1460 + nonfarm nonresidential BHDM1480 (domestic offices, reported by all Y-9C filers; = phase-4 pre-2007 items). The consolidated BHCK1415 / 1460 / 1480 versions exist only 1990Q3-1991Q4 and only for about 1,430 filers (equal to BHDM in > 99% where both exist); a BHCK value is used only if the BHDM value is missing (used 0 times)
y9c_items_1990s.RRE: BHDM1797 + BHDM1798 for reports dated 1990-09-30 and 1990-12-31 (BHDM1798 = all other loans secured by 1-4 family residential properties, the predecessor item); BHDM1797 + BHDM5367 + BHDM5368 from 1991-03-31 (phase-4 items). BHDM1410 = sum of the BHDM real-estate parts in 100% of rows in every quarter
y9c_items_1990s.CC: BHCK2008 (credit cards and related plans), reports from 1991-03-31 (same substitution as phase 4 used for 2000)
y9c_items_1990s.OC: BHCK2011 (other consumer loans), reports from 1991-03-31 (phase-4 2000 substitution). BHCK2008 + BHCK2011 = BHCK1975 in 100% of rows 1991Q1-2000Q2
y9c_items_1990s.consumer_1990Q3_Q4: reports dated 1990-09-30 and 1990-12-31 have no CC / OC split: the consumer total BHCK1975 enters the five-category total as CONS and share_CC / share_OC are undefined. These reports can only be used at releases before 1996 (CI and CRE categories only), so BT is unaffected; a bank whose report lacks the share of an available category is excluded at that release (count logged, expected 0)
y9c_items_1990s.missing_negative: phase-4 rule: within a usable row a missing component item counts 0, negative values 0 (none found). Counts logged in logs/p4b_11
y9c_items_1990s.shares: share_k = component / L with L = CI + CRE + RRE + CONS and CONS = CC + OC from 1991-03-31. Raw share_CRE (CRE / L) is the H2 sorting variable (= phase-4 bank-table share_CRE used by the post-hoc addendum). Renormalised shares sh2_k over the available categories enter BT (phase-4 rule)
y9c_items_1990s.reporting_threshold: FR Y-9C filers in the 1990s include holding companies below $150M total assets (about 330-420 per quarter before 1994Q1, about 20-60 after; logs/p4b_10_bhcf_coverage.csv). No asset filter is added (spec has none); listed banks without a Y-9C report have no signal and drop out (counts logged)

timing_1990s.lag_75d: q*(r) = latest calendar quarter-end q with r - q >= 75 days, r = the exact release date or, for approximate releases, the approximate date (earlier than the entry, hence conservative). The bank uses its report dated q*(r); if absent, its latest usable report dated in [q*(r) - 183 days, q*(r)); else no signal (phase-4 rule)
timing_1990s.entry: exact date: close of the first CRSP trading day strictly after r (phase 4). Approximate date: close of the 10th trading day strictly after the approximate date, t0 = cal[first_after(approx) + 9] (spec section 2: approximate date + 10 trading days). For the 1997-2024 releases with known dates, this rule never enters on or before the actual release day (minimum slack 8 calendar days, logs/p4b_13)
timing_1990s.decision_date: D = the trading day before t0. Exact releases: link and name validity evaluated at r and the price screen at the last record <= D (= last trading day <= r; identical to phase 4). Approximate releases: link / name validity and the price screen at D (= approximate date + 9 trading days). 'Entry decision date' of spec section 2. Price records at most 5 trading days stale
timing_1990s.exit: close of t0 of the next SLOOS release in the release table (formed or not); the last period (2000-05-19 release) exits at the close of 2000-08-28 = the first entry of phase-4 S1 (asserted). Buy-and-hold within the period

universe_1990s.link: phase-4 rule: link rows with inst_type 'bank holding company', valid iff dt_start <= D <= dt_end (dt_end equal to the table maximum treated as open-ended; irrelevant before 2024)
universe_1990s.common_stock: dsenames spell valid at D with shrcd 10/11 and exchcd 1/2/3; several permnos of a permco -> largest market cap at the screen date; one rssd with several permcos -> largest cap; one permco with several rssd -> largest bhck2170 of the report used (phase-4 rule)
universe_1990s.screen: |prc| >= $5 and market cap = |prc| x shrout x 1000 >= $100M at the screen date (nominal thresholds as written in the spec). 'No filter' variant drops both (reported, not in the verdict)
universe_1990s.entry_valid: a stock needs a total-return index record <= t0 at most 5 trading days stale and a price at t0, else it is excluded at that release (phase-4 rule)

returns.1990s: phase-4 rule unchanged: legacy dsf ret, missing or < -1 -> 0; delisting records with dlstcd >= 200 appended at max(dlstdt, last dsf date + 1 day), missing dlret with dlstcd 500-599 -> -0.30 (exchcd 1, 2) / -0.55 (exchcd 3), other missing -> 0; after the last record the position is cash (0%) to the period end; holding return R = I(exit) / I(entry) - 1 in %
returns.2025: dsf_v2 dlyret (missing -> 0, < -1 -> 0). CIZ already carries the delisting return as the security's final daily record (dlydelflg = 'Y', dated the trading day after stkdelists.delistingdt, dlyret = delret in 32 of 33 cases; the 33rd, a liquidation with payment 'UNAV', has a missing return -> 0, as phase-4 treats a missing non-500 delisting return). Therefore NO separate delisting return is appended for dsf_v2 (avoids double counting). Prices: dlyprc > 0 only (the delisting rows carry price 0 and are not price records); cap = dlyprc x shrout x 1000 (dlycap = dlyprc x shrout to 7e-7)

signal_and_portfolios.BT: BT(i, r) = sum over available categories of sh2(i, k) x N(k, r), N in % (spec / phase 4)
signal_and_portfolios.quintiles: per formed release, within the bank set (main = screened; no-filter = all banks with a signal and a valid entry): rank ascending, ties by permno (stable sort), quintile = ceil(5 x rank / n). A period needs n >= 25 in the main set, else it is dropped (count logged). The BT sort (H1) and the raw share_CRE sort (H2) use the same bank set
signal_and_portfolios.H1: LS_BT(p) = EW mean R of BT quintile 1 (lowest BT, LONG) - EW mean R of BT quintile 5 (highest BT, SHORT), in % per holding period. Statistic: time-series mean over formed periods, t from OLS on a constant with Newey-West HAC 1 lag (phase-4 nw_mean, statsmodels cov_type HAC, maxlags 1, default settings). Expected sign positive
signal_and_portfolios.H2: LS_CRE(p) = EW mean R of the lowest raw-CRE-share quintile - EW mean R of the highest, in %. Statistic: OLS LS_CRE(p) = a + b x N_CRE(p) / 10 + e over formed periods, b in % per 10 pp of CRE net tightening, t on b with Newey-West HAC 1 lag. Expected sign of b positive
signal_and_portfolios.H2_panel: companion (spec): bank-level pooled regression on the main universe, R(i, p) in % on release fixed effects + share_CRE + share_CI + I_CRE, I_CRE = share_CRE x (N_CRE(p) - mean of N_CRE over the formed releases of the sample, one value per release) / 10; estimated by within-release demeaning, standard errors clustered by release (statsmodels cluster, use_correction=True, as in _main_checks/s1_phase4_addendum.py). Expected sign of the I_CRE coefficient negative. With share_CRE in the regression the I_CRE coefficient does not depend on the centring constant. Reported with its own label; it does not replace the H2 verdict
signal_and_portfolios.no_filter: H1, H2 slope and H2 panel recomputed on the no-filter bank set (spec section 2 'unconditional universe also reported'); reported only

inference_and_verdict.rule: PHASE4B_SPEC section 3, decided before the data: confirmed = expected sign and |t| >= 1.96; consistent = expected sign and |t| < 1.96; refuted = opposite sign (|t| >= 1.96 -> strongly refuted). H1 is judged on the t of mean LS_BT, H2 on the t of the slope b; both are reported, neither is chosen over the other
inference_and_verdict.splits: descriptive (spec section 5): release year 1990-1992 (formed periods are 1991-1992 only, 8 periods) and release year 1993 .. 2000-05 (30 periods; the spec's '1993-1999' plus the two 2000 releases so that the two parts partition the sample); the strict 1993-1999 part (28 periods) is printed too. Not used for the verdict
inference_and_verdict.exploratory: EXPLORATORY (post hoc, declared now, not in the verdict): the same statistics on the 13 exact-dated periods (1997-02 .. 2000-05), because the approximate release dates are the largest timing uncertainty of the 1990s sample

post_sample_2025.releases: US SLOOS releases after the last complete phase-4 period whose holding period ends by 2025-12-31: 2024-11-12, 2025-02-03, 2025-05-12, 2025-08-04 (4 periods; the 2025-11-03 release's period would end 2026-02-03 and is excluded). The 2024-11-12 period was dropped in phase 4 only because legacy dsf ends 2024-12-31
post_sample_2025.construction: phase-4 S1 code with the period limit lifted: exact release dates, t0 = first trading day after r, exit = t0 of the next release, Y-9C = dump panel with the 75-day rule (q* 2024-06-30, 2024-09-30, 2024-12-31, 2025-03-31), N from s1_N_by_release.csv (all five categories available), screen at the close of r, same quintile rules; H1 = LS_BT per period, H2 = LS_CRE per period with N_CRE / 10 (no regression)
post_sample_2025.link_and_names: link table: phase-4 rule (dt_end = table maximum 2024-09-30 treated as open-ended, i.e. the last link is kept). dsenames: spells with nameendt equal to the table maximum 2024-12-31 are treated as open-ended (last name kept, shrcd / exchcd of that spell). Both stated as assumptions. Check (reported only): for the stocks used, the CIZ stocknames_v2 spell valid at r is compared with common stock on NYSE / AMEX / NASDAQ (securitytype EQTY, securitysubtype COM, sharetype NS, usincflg Y, primaryexch N / A / Q)
post_sample_2025.data_path_check: the last phase-4 S1 period (release 2024-08-05, 2024-08-06 .. 2024-11-13) is recomputed with dsf_v2 in place of legacy dsf and compared with phase4/out/s1_ls_periods.csv (validation of the 2025 data path only)

self_checks: q*(r) + 75 days <= r and every report used is dated in [q*(r) - 183 days, q*(r)] (asserted)
t0 > r for every release; approximate releases enter on the 10th trading day after the approximate date (asserted)
exact releases: screen date = last trading day <= r, identical to phase 4 (asserted)
renormalised shares sum to 1 over the available categories; raw shares CI + CRE + RRE + CONS sum to 1 (asserted)
one row per permno, permco and rssd per release (asserted)
delisted positions per period counted; listed banks below $150M assets in the main universe counted

outputs.bank_table: out/h1h2_1990s_bank_table.parquet and .csv: per release x bank - period, fred_date, release_date, approx_date, decision_date, t0, exit, qstar, permno, permco, rssd9001, y9c_date, raw shares (CI, CRE, RRE, CC, OC, CONS), renormalised shares, available categories, BT, BT and CRE quintiles (main, no-filter), screen, R, prices and caps, delisting flag, loan balances
outputs.periods: out/h1h2_1990s_periods.csv (main) and out/h1h2_1990s_periods_nofilter.csv: per formed period LS_BT, legs, LS_CRE, legs, counts, N by category
outputs.counts: out/h1h2_1990s_counts.csv (per release: linked rssd, common stocks, with Y-9C signal, with entry, main universe, quintile sizes, delisted, small filers)
outputs.results: out/results_1990s.csv and out/results_2025.csv (test_id, sample, stat, value); out/results.csv = both

deviations.when: first run of scripts/p4b_20_h1h2_1990s.py, after the per-release counts table was printed and before any return statistic was computed
deviations.what: KeyError: the per-period N lookup used per.set_index('period') although the period id is the index of 'per'; replaced by per[[N_*]].rename_axis('period'). No statistic existed before the fix; nothing else changed

deviations.id: NOTE-2 (post hoc additions, reported as EXPLORATORY, not in the verdict)
deviations.when: after the H1 / H2 results were seen
deviations.what: scripts/p4b_22_exploratory.py: (E1) leave-one-release-year-out range of the H1 and H2 t; (E2) H2 slope on the previous survey's N_CRE (certainly public at every entry), to bound the approximate-release-date timing risk; (E3) the per-period table. Also a count-only column n_common_screen (screened linked listed banks before the Y-9C merge) added to out/h1h2_1990s_counts.csv - it changes no statistic. No frozen parameter was changed and no new variant enters the verdict
